title: PlannerSetupError
description: The `error` payload of a failure on the planner's `/setup/...` routes (`{"error": <this>}`). Closed: `setup_project_unknown` (404, no setup task is held for the project key), `setup_step_unknown` (422, `step` is not one of the five step ids), `setup_progress_invalid` (422, the report does not fit `planner.setup-progress-request`). NOTE: planner commit 111a727 declares the codes `unknown_project`, `unknown_step`, `invalid_progress` in domain/errors.py while its CHANGELOG, DEPLOYMENT and the demand name the `setup_*` forms; this schema follows the demand and the planner must emit these codes.
